title: Prostatitis treatment
what: Prostatitis is inflammation of the prostate gland. Treatment depends on the cause: sometimes it is an infection, sometimes not.
why: For pain low in the belly or between the legs, burning, and peeing often.
duration: the visit takes 20 to 40 minutes; treatment usually lasts several weeks or more
tell_doctor: Where it hurts and for how long
If you have a fever and chills
How often you pee and if it is hard to pee
What medicines you already took, including antibiotics

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: The doctor usually orders a urine test, sometimes a prostate fluid test and an ultrasound.

prepare.title: Before the test
prepare.text: For some tests, you need to avoid sex for a few days. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not start antibiotics on your own before the visit. It can affect the test results.

steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms
You are examined, and the prostate is checked through the rectum
Tests are taken, and an ultrasound is done if needed
The doctor explains how and for how long to take the medicines
feel: The rectal exam is unpleasant but short
Improvement usually comes gradually, not right away
after: Finish the whole course, even if you feel better
Come back to check the result
Avoid getting cold and sitting for a long time
red_flags: You cannot pee at all: call emergency services
Blood in the urine or severe pain

faq.a: Acute prostatitis is usually cured. Chronic prostatitis can often be kept under control. The doctor chooses the treatment.
Prostatitis itself does not spread. But if the cause is an infection, the doctor may order tests for your partner too.

reminders.text: Prostatitis visit tomorrow. Bring past tests and your list of medicines.
